shuffled_fibre_control.stratification: One seeded random 512-row block per 16 blocks; independently permute spectrum indices in each wavelength bin while moving the flux and error together.

domain: All catalog observations. z_HeII 1.9–2.4 truncated at spectral coverage. Lyα ≥7σ, HeII 4.5≤S/N<7 with observed flux ratio ≥0.1. Both <900 km/s FWHM, clean multi-pixel profiles. HeII EW0 ≥3 Å when continuum ≥3σ. Any ≥3σ C IV, C III], O III] component vetoes. Undetected or out-of-band metals still require deep external spectroscopy.
control: ±76 vacuum-Angstrom cyclic displacement of the HeII prediction over identical anchor range. Same anchor, masks, fit, velocity −300 to +600 km/s, profile, ratio and metal cuts. Rates are spectral preselection chance-alignment diagnostics; offsets are not independently vetted.
injections: Random z uniform 1.9–2.4, source spectra including real noise, calibration masks and lines; Gaussian widths 2, 3, 4 Å, uniform velocity −300..600 km/s. Matched nominal HeII S/N 4.5, 5.5, 6.5, 8 and Lyα S/N 9, 14, 22. Recovery requires both centroids within 7 Å, full spectral preselection, and absence of a pre-existing pair. Additional blank-sky fibres are separately measured by the principal search. No injection success implies astrophysical completeness.
